messages:
priya: Quick postmortem follow-up list from today's DR incident. I'm enumerating remediation tasks, owners, and a first-pass ETA. Please reply with any objections or earlier dates. Main issues: partial route withdrawal in us-east causing 20% traffic split, two 1-hour restores that required manual KMS creds, and backup verifies failing silently for a subset of AZs.

marco: taking R1 (route convergence & withdraw tuning). I'll add a jittered withdraw delay + extend healthcheck grace from 5s -> 12s. Also want a circuit-breaker test harness. ETA 2026-04-12, ticket OPS-4001.

kevin: taking R2 (cross-region failover playbook). I'll consolidate the regional steps, add explicit VIP rebind commands and a pre-failover checklist. ETA 2026-04-05. Linking draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-failover/draft

lin: taking R3 (backups + verify). Plan: nightly verify across all AZs, quick-restore smoke to staging each weekday, and alert on missing manifests. ETA 2026-03-31. I'll create a job in Jenkins and a Datadog monitor.

priya: R4 (KMS key access & rotations) - I'll add a noninteractive recovery key flow for oncall and document how to rotate and test keys. Also adding a step to confirm key access in the pre-restore checklist. ETA 2026-04-02, doc ticket DOCS-220.

dana: R5 (automate runbook steps) - will script the manual steps that slowed restores (VIP bind, route-check, db read-only toggle) and land as a one-command helper. ETA 2026-04-10, PR to infra-helpers.

marco: note about recurring pattern 1 we saw similar partial splits during large traffic spikes after deploys. Suggest adding a deploy gating test that simulates a 30% region loss.

lin: will add a telemetry tag for failure-mode=replay so we can track recurrence across weeks. Add to dashboard too.

priya: proposed game-day schedule:
- 2026-04-07: tabletop (30m) to walk the new checklist
- 2026-04-21: warm failover drill (eu-west) full run (2h)
- Monthly thereafter with rotating regions
calendar-bot: Event created -> "DR warm-failover drill (eu-west)" on 2026-04-21 14:00 UTC (organizer: priya)

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook-lint check failing for DR doc. See OPS-4001/docs for required fields.

kevin: action tracker snapshot (from thread):
- R1 route tuning: owner=marco, ETA=2026-04-12, ticket=OPS-4001
- R2 playbook consolidation: owner=kevin, ETA=2026-04-05, doc=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-failover/draft
- R3 backup verify: owner=lin, ETA=2026-03-31, job=JENK-879
- R4 KMS recovery flow: owner=priya, ETA=2026-04-02, ticket=DOCS-220
- R5 runbook automation: owner=dana, ETA=2026-04-10, branch=infra/failover-helper

marco: small config example I'll add to the RFC to avoid aggressive withdrawals:
```bash
# increase withdraw grace to 12s
route-map WITHDRAW permit 10
 set local-preference 100
 set community no-export
!
bgp withdraw-grace 12
```

lin: I'll dashboard the daily restore success rate and add a weekly digest to #incidents with top failing AZs.

priya: let's keep this thread as the canonical place for status updates until all ETAs are met. I'll do a Monday roundup. If anyone needs earlier SLAs, ping me.

kevin: ack. Adding owners to the remediation sheet and escalating any high-risk items. :thumbsup:

marco: ack

lin: ack

kevin: closing for now 1 will re-open if blockers appear.
